method: Actual native PNG visual inspection and read-only per-pixel RGBA samples. No image processing. Coordinates below are bottom-left in each native crop; annotation uncertainty approximately 3px.
observations: Navy ballpoint hatching, ivory metal and rounded blue ink capsules replace brass pointed ammunition.
Six disjoint native crops; asymmetric gutters preserve the cradle beyond the nominal 512px column.
Original gameplay part IDs/revisions remain unchanged. Source images are copied natively without resampling.
residuals: Detailed fasteners retain small bright highlights; the hand-drawn source sketch uses calmer accents.
A mechanical cradle represents the stock sight; optic alternatives retain their established distinct silhouettes.

crops.note: Rotation centre intentionally lies in the open hole; modern fixed support uses the separate TurnHub sprite.
Final uniform scale is height-constrained, preserving the old maximum physical height and horizontal centre; preliminary width-match was not adopted.
